principle: A quest with a world target is generated only when a sensible real target exists. Never fall back to an arbitrarily distant structure just to fill a board slot.

candidate_search.comment: Structure location can be expensive. Cache per settlement/board + target family + policy cell; do not run a broad locate every board refresh.

LOCAL_SITE.description: Ordinary board recovery/investigation site. Should feel like a trip outside town, not an expedition across the map.

REGIONAL_EXPEDITION.description: Named dungeon, Great Hunt, substantial recovery, or serious regional expedition in the board's current radial tier.

OUTWARD_LEAD.description: A deliberate one-tier-outward clue. Rare; never presented as a local errand.

LEGENDARY_DESTINATION.description: Explicit story/finale knowledge only. Not eligible for random repeatable board generation.

selection_order: enumerate candidate instances inside the scope hard maximum
reject candidates that CozyCrazyZones says are illegal at their actual position
reject candidates outside the quest's allowed radial tier and macro-region
reject candidates inside the scope minimum distance
reject active/recent duplicate targets when another candidate exists
for outward leads, reject targets that do not move materially farther from world spawn
score the survivors around the scope ideal distance rather than blindly choosing nearest
prefer stronger established-region placement over macro-boundary fringe when otherwise similar
prefer unexplored/unassigned targets when that information is available
if nothing survives, withhold the quest or map

prototype_limits.note: These are locator search radii, not guaranteed straight-line target distances. They are useful natural caps for the low-code prototype.
